test_Categorical_argsort: test the Categorical.argsort method to sort ordered categorical data ascending and descending
test_numpy_argsort_Categorical: test numpy argsort on an ordered Categorical array with kind and unsupported parameter handling
test_Categorical_sort_values: test Categorical.sort_values for ordered and unordered categories with ascending and descending options
test_Categorical_sort_values_inplace: test Categorical.sort_values with inplace=True to sort categories in place preserving codes
test_Categorical_sort_values_na_position: test Categorical.sort_values with na_position first and last for ascending and descending order
